fusions.name: Tear-Out Barb
fusions.desc: Fires a barbed arrow that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Reeling Line
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile line of barbed cord ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Long Cast
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Barb Retrieval
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 3 seconds.
